pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Beverwijk Variation
pages.notes: Overview called the f8-bishop light-squared; plan 4 took on d4 before White has a pawn there. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Duras Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote an ambiguous Nd2-f1-g3 (either knight); now Nbd2. British spelling and Maróczy diacritic.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Fishing Pole Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote h3-h5 as one route; overview and plans made concrete (hxg4 hxg4 opens the h-file). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Kaufmann Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 played fxe3 without the ...Bxe3 that must come first, and called the f-file open. Reworded. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Variation, Zukertort Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 put d4 inside Black's plan; reworded. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Berlin, 4.d3 Bc5
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote c3-d4 and d2-f1 as routes and moved the b5-bishop straight to c2; plan 2 played ...b5. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Berlin, 4.d3 d6
pages.notes: Plan 2 said ...Be7 breaks the pin on c6 (...Bd7 does) and rerouted a b8-knight that is on c6; plans 1 and 3 wrote ambiguous or impossible knight routes; plan 4 played ...b5 and claimed d-file control. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Berlin, 4.d3 d6 5.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 moved the bishop to c2 without the route; plan 2 played ...b5. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Berlin, 4.Qe2
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...b5 onto the bishop; reworded. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Berlin Defense, Closed Showalter Variation
pages.notes: Overview said Bxc6 gives White the better pawn structure (the d7-bishop recaptures); plan 2 played ...c5 before the recapture. Rewritten. British spelling.
